places.name: Loma de la Cruz (Holguín Viewpoint)
places.ai_summary: Loma de la Cruz is a famous viewpoint in Holguín, offering panoramic views of the city and surrounding landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunrise or sunset for stunning views.

places.place_tip: Climb the 458 steps to the top for the best experience.
places.address: Loma de la Cruz, Holguín, Cuba

places.name: Parque Calixto García
places.ai_summary: Parque Calixto García is a historic park in the heart of Holguín, surrounded by colonial buildings and vibrant local life.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Relax on a bench and enjoy the local ambiance.

attribution.title: Flag of Cuba
attribution.author: Miguel Teurbe Tolón and Narciso López
attribution.credit:
Geometry and dimensions from Ley no 42 "de los Símbolos Nacionales".

Its shape is rectangular, twice length than width, composed by five horizontal stripes having all the same width, three deep blue and two white, placed alternating. A red equilateral triangle, in one of its vertical extremes occupy all the height of the flag constituting its fixed edge. Such triangle bears in its center a five-pointed white star, within an imaginary circumference, whose diameter is a third of the flag´s height, having one of its points towards the free upper edge of the flag.— English translation of Law 42 from Symbols of the Cuban Nation
attribution.description: The flag of Cuba. Colors are from http://www.nacion.cult.cu/fr/sobrebandera.htm

places.name: Museo Provincial La Periquera
places.ai_summary: Museo Provincial La Periquera is a museum showcasing the history and culture of Holguín, housed in a historic colonial building.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on public holidays.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the exhibits in detail.
places.address: Museo Provincial La Periquera, Holguín, Cuba

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times and special events.

places.place_tip: Respect the dress code when visiting this religious site.
places.address: Catedral de San Isidoro, Holguín, Cuba

places.name: Aldea Taína (Baconao-style Exhibit)
places.ai_summary: Aldea Taína is a cultural site near Holguín, featuring a replica of a Taíno village and offering insights into the indigenous culture.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Participate in a cultural workshop if available.

places.name: Guardalavaca Beach
places.ai_summary: Guardalavaca Beach is a beautiful beach located in the Holguín province, known for its clear waters and coral reefs.

opening_hours.notes: Best beach for snorkeling and water sports.

places.place_tip: Bring your own snorkeling gear for the best experience.

attribution.description: Statue of Christopher Columbus in Guardalavaca, Cuba, near Playa Baní.

places.name: Playa Esmeralda
places.ai_summary: Playa Esmeralda is a stunning beach in Holguín, famous for its fine white sand and crystal-clear turquoise waters.

opening_hours.notes: Ideal for sunbathing and swimming.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby coral reefs for snorkeling.

places.name: Bahía de Naranjo Dolphinarium
places.ai_summary: Bahía de Naranjo Dolphinarium is a popular attraction in Holguín, where visitors can swim with dolphins and enjoy marine shows.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended for swimming with dolphins.

places.place_tip: Bring a waterproof camera for memorable photos.

places.name: Cayo Saetía Wildlife Reserve
places.ai_summary: Cayo Saetía is a wildlife reserve in Holguín, known for its diverse fauna and beautiful beaches.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited with a guided tour for wildlife spotting.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking in the reserve.

places.name: Chorro de Maíta Museum & Burial Site
places.ai_summary: Chorro de Maíta is an archaeological site in Holguín, featuring a museum and the burial site of indigenous Taíno people.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available in Spanish and English.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to Aldea Taína for a complete experience.

places.name: Arroyo Bermejo Beach
places.ai_summary: Arroyo Bermejo Beach is a secluded beach in Holguín, known for its natural beauty and tranquility.

opening_hours.notes: Bring your own food and drinks, as facilities are limited.

places.place_tip: Explore the nearby mangroves for birdwatching.

places.ai_summary: Gibara is a charming fishing town near Holguín, famous for its colonial architecture and annual film festival.

opening_hours.notes: Visit the town square for local events and festivals.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood at a paladar (private restaurant).

places.name: Cayo Bariay (Landing Park of Columbus)
places.ai_summary: Cayo Bariay is a historical site in Holguín, known as the landing site of Christopher Columbus in 1492.

opening_hours.notes: Check for guided tour availability.

places.place_tip: Visit the small museum to learn about the site's history.

places.name: Mirador de Mayabe
places.ai_summary: Mirador de Mayabe is a scenic viewpoint in Holguín, offering breathtaking views of the city and the bay.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited at sunrise for a magical experience.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views.
